records.context: IMPORTANT: pass a `parent` (typically the panel that owns this stream). Without a Qt parent the QThread's C++ object gets tied exclusively to Python's refcount — and dropping the ref while QThread.isRunning() is still True (which happens in the tiny window between worker.run returning and thread.finished firing) triggers Qt's `QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running / Aborted` crash. A parent keeps the C++ object alive until deleteLater runs.

records.source: IMPORTANT: pass a `parent` (typically the panel that owns this stream). Without a Qt parent the QThread's C++ object gets tied exclusively to Python's refcount — and dropping the ref while QThread.isRunning() is still True (which happens in the tiny window between worker.run returning and thread.finished firing) triggers Qt's `QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running / Aborted` crash. A parent keeps the C++ object alive until deleteLater runs.
records.translation: 중요: `parent`(일반적으로 이 스트림을 소유하는 패널)를 전달하십시오. Qt 부모가 없으면 QThread의 C++ 객체가 Python의 참조 카운트에만 묶이며, QThread.isRunning()이 아직 True인 상태에서 참조가 사라지면(worker.run 호출이 반환된 뒤 thread.finished 시그널이 발생하기 전의 아주 짧은 구간에 일어납니다) Qt의 `QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running / Aborted` 충돌이 발생합니다. 부모가 있으면 deleteLater 호출이 실행될 때까지 C++ 객체가 유지됩니다.

records.context: These are not a procedural sky of point stars — ``cell.png``'s cyan core fills most of the frame and measures 0.236 in the brightest text-line-sized window, which is far too bright to put white-on-nothing text over. So each master is dimmed at build time by a factor solved from the palette: :func:`spacr.qt.theme.max_background_luma` returns the brightest a bare window background may be before some role that gets painted straight onto it (``fg``, ``fg_muted``, ``accent``, ``fg_dim``, the status hues) drops below its WCAG minimum, and :func:`solve_dim` scales the image in linear light until the brightest :data:`TEXT_WINDOW`-sized region lands on that number less :data:`SAFETY_MARGIN`.

So each master is dimmed at build time by a factor solved from the palette: :func:`spacr.qt.theme.max_background_luma` returns the brightest a bare window background may be before some role that gets painted straight onto it (``fg``, ``fg_muted``, ``accent``, ``fg_dim``, the status hues) drops below its WCAG minimum, and :func:`solve_dim` scales the image in linear light until the brightest :data:`TEXT_WINDOW`-sized region lands on that number less :data:`SAFETY_MARGIN`.
records.translation: 이 이미지들은 점 같은 별로 이루어진 절차적 하늘이 아닙니다 — ``cell.png``의 청록색 중심부는 프레임 대부분을 채우며, 텍스트 한 줄 크기의 가장 밝은 창에서 0.236으로 측정되어 아무 배경 없이 흰색 텍스트를 올리기에는 지나치게 밝습니다. 그래서 각 마스터는 빌드 시 팔레트로부터 계산한 계수만큼 어둡게 처리됩니다: :func:`spacr.qt.theme.max_background_luma`는 창 배경 위에 직접 칠해지는 역할(``fg``, ``fg_muted``, ``accent``, ``fg_dim``, 상태 색조) 중 어느 하나가 WCAG 최솟값 아래로 떨어지기 전까지 맨 창 배경이 가질 수 있는 최대 밝기를 반환하며, :func:`solve_dim`은 가장 밝은 :data:`TEXT_WINDOW` 크기 영역이 그 값에서 :data:`SAFETY_MARGIN`을 뺀 값에 도달할 때까지 선형 광량 공간에서 이미지를 조정합니다.

records.translation: 픽셀이 최종적으로 어떤 값이 될지를 결정하는 모든 것은 Qt를 전혀 모르는 :mod:`spacr.layers`에 있습니다. 이 모듈은 디스플레이가 있어야만 존재할 수 있는 부분입니다: 모델의 합성 결과를 그리는 캔버스, 순서를 바꾸는 레이어 목록, 그리고 모델이 이미 처리할 줄 아는 속성을 설정하는 컨트롤입니다.

records.source: Why this canvas paints rather than reusing ``_ZoomView``
records.translation: 이 캔버스가 ``_ZoomView``를 재사용하지 않고 직접 그리는 이유

records.context: :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview._ZoomView` is the right answer when the thing being shown is a finished pixmap: it scales what it was given. Here the zoom is a property of the world, not of the picture — zooming in means :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.zoomed` and a fresh render at the new resolution, which is how the labels layer stays crisp at 8× and how the orthogonal-view item gets its slice sliders for free. So the canvas owns a :class:`~spacr.layers.Canvas` and paints; the array→pixmap step still goes through :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.numpy_to_qpixmap`, and file loading through :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.load_preview_image`, rather than growing a third copy of either.

records.source: :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview._ZoomView` is the right answer when the thing being shown is a finished pixmap: it scales what it was given. Here the zoom is a property of the world, not of the picture — zooming in means :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.zoomed` and a fresh render at the new resolution, which is how the labels layer stays crisp at 8× and how the orthogonal-view item gets its slice sliders for free. So the canvas owns a :class:`~spacr.layers.Canvas` and paints; the array→pixmap step still goes through :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.numpy_to_qpixmap`, and file loading through :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.load_preview_image`, rather than growing a third copy of either.
records.translation: 보여 줄 대상이 완성된 픽스맵이라면 :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview._ZoomView`가 정답입니다: 받은 것을 확대/축소합니다. 여기서는 확대가 그림이 아니라 월드의 속성입니다 — 확대란 :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.zoomed`와 새 해상도에서의 새 렌더링을 의미하며, 이 덕분에 레이블 레이어는 8×에서도 선명하고 직교 뷰 항목은 슬라이스 슬라이더를 공짜로 얻습니다. 따라서 캔버스는 :class:`~spacr.layers.Canvas`를 소유하고 직접 그립니다. 배열→픽스맵 단계는 여전히 :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.numpy_to_qpixmap`를, 파일 불러오기는 :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.load_preview_image`를 거치며, 어느 쪽도 세 번째 사본을 만들지 않습니다.

records.context: ``clear VRAM`` ``torch.cuda.empty_cache()``, which hands the CUDA driver back the blocks torch reserved and is no longer using, plus releasing any model reference spaCR itself is holding (:data:`MODEL_RELEASERS`). **It cannot reclaim another process's VRAM** — no process can — and it cannot free a tensor an executing spaCR job is still using, which is the point rather than a limitation.
records.label: spacr.qt.resource_cleanup#10

records.source: ``clear VRAM`` ``torch.cuda.empty_cache()``, which hands the CUDA driver back the blocks torch reserved and is no longer using, plus releasing any model reference spaCR itself is holding (:data:`MODEL_RELEASERS`). **It cannot reclaim another process's VRAM** — no process can — and it cannot free a tensor a running spaCR job is still using, which is the point rather than a limitation.
records.translation: ``clear VRAM`` ``torch.cuda.empty_cache()``로 torch가 예약했지만 더 이상 사용하지 않는 블록을 CUDA 드라이버에 돌려주고, spaCR 자신이 보유한 모델 참조도 해제합니다(:data:`MODEL_RELEASERS`). **다른 프로세스의 VRAM은 회수할 수 없으며** — 어떤 프로세스도 할 수 없습니다 — 실행 중인 spaCR 작업이 아직 사용하는 텐서도 해제할 수 없습니다. 이는 한계가 아니라 의도된 동작입니다.

records.context: ``clear CPU`` Releases parked background execution units that have since exited (:func:`spacr.qt.bridge.prune_parked_threads`), lets Qt's global pool retire its idle independent execution paths, and lowers spaCR's own library worker-count limits (torch, OpenCV) to a floor. It retires *idle* capacity only: work that is queued or executing is left exactly where it is.

It retires *idle* capacity only: work that is queued or running is left exactly where it is.
records.translation: ``clear CPU`` 이미 종료된 보류 작업자 스레드를 해제하고(:func:`spacr.qt.bridge.prune_parked_threads`), Qt 전역 풀이 유휴 스레드를 정리하게 하며, spaCR 자체 라이브러리(torch, OpenCV)의 스레드 수를 하한까지 낮춥니다. *유휴* 용량만 정리합니다: 대기 중이거나 실행 중인 작업은 그대로 둡니다.

records.translation: "Free as many resources as possible"(가능한 한 많은 자원 해제)는 spaCR가 소유하지 않은 것에 절대 닿아서는 안 됩니다. 이 컴퓨터는 다른 사람의 작업도 실행합니다: 분할이 4초 일찍 시작된다고 해서 누군가의 8시간짜리 학습 실행을 희생할 가치는 없으며, 사용자를 대신해 다르게 판단하는 도구는 아무도 켜 둔 채 둘 수 없습니다.

records.context: **No process is ever killed.** Not by name, not by "python processes using a lot of memory", not spaCR's own children. There is no ``os.kill``, no ``signal``, no ``subprocess``, no ``Process.terminate()``, no ``QThread.terminate()`` anywhere in this module or reachable from it. The Qt layer removed ``QThread.terminate()`` outright; a stubborn independent execution path is *parked* by :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread`, and that is the strongest thing any of this may do.

records.source: **No process is ever killed.** Not by name, not by "python processes using a lot of memory", not spaCR's own children. There is no ``os.kill``, no ``signal``, no ``subprocess``, no ``Process.terminate()``, no ``QThread.terminate()`` anywhere in this module or reachable from it. records.translation: **어떤 프로세스도 종료하지 않습니다.** 이름으로도, "python processes using a lot of memory"(메모리를 많이 쓰는 파이썬 프로세스)라는 기준으로도, spaCR 자신의 자식 프로세스도 종료하지 않습니다. 이 모듈이나 이 모듈에서 도달 가능한 어디에도 ``os.kill``, ``signal``, ``subprocess``, ``Process.terminate()``, ``QThread.terminate()``가 없습니다. The generated sky never went through it, and it showed: measured at 1440x900, the brightest text-line-sized region of the ``galaxy`` sky was 0.4879 against a 0.0586 limit (8.3x over), ``sun`` 0.8201 (14.0x) and ``stars`` 0.5041 (8.6x). records.translation: :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery`는 항상 모든 사진 마스터를 :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.solve_dim`으로 처리하여 :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.exposure_target` — 맨 창 배경 위의 흰색 텍스트가 WCAG AA 아래로 떨어지기 전까지 배경이 가질 수 있는 최대 밝기 — 에 맞춰 왔습니다. 생성된 하늘은 이 과정을 거친 적이 없었고, 그 결과가 드러났습니다: 1440x900에서 측정한 결과, 텍스트 한 줄 크기의 가장 밝은 영역은 0.0586 한계에 대해 ``galaxy`` 하늘이 0.4879(8.3x 초과), ``sun``이 0.8201(14.0x), ``stars``가 0.5041(8.6x)이었습니다. 그 위의 맨 흰색 텍스트는 4.5:1이 필요한 곳에서 1.20-1.96:1로 측정되었습니다 — 제목 표시줄의 "AI" 토글이 태양의 후광 위에 놓여 있었습니다. 이제 :func:`render`가 이를 계산하며, :func:`legibility`는 :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.legibility`가 사진에 대해 반환하는 것과 같은 측정 dict를 보고합니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.space#14

records.source: Reconciling the limit with the 40th-percentile anchor
records.translation: 한계와 40번째 백분위수 기준점의 조정

records.context: :data:`TARGET_SKY_PERCENTILE` exposes the frame so that *empty sky* — not the mean — lands on :data:`TARGET_SKY_LUMA`, deliberately, so that a sun stays blown out instead of dragging the whole frame to black. Taken as a statement about one global exposure that is now flatly incompatible with the limit, and both of the obvious ways to force it are ruined pictures. Re-solving the exposure, or dimming the finished frame with :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.solve_dim`, needs a factor of 0.064-0.108; both take the sky's own 40th percentile from 0.00091 to 0.00000, i.e. every faint star and the whole nebula go to pure black, and the peak pixel falls from 236-252 to 67-90. Measured, rendered and looked at: a dark grey smudge.
records.label: spacr.qt.space#15
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :data:`TARGET_SKY_PERCENTILE` exposes the frame so that *empty sky* — not the mean — lands on :data:`TARGET_SKY_LUMA`, deliberately, so that a sun stays blown out instead of dragging the whole frame to black. Taken as a statement about one global exposure that is now flatly incompatible with the limit, and both of the obvious ways to force it are ruined pictures. Re-solving the exposure, or dimming the finished frame with :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.solve_dim`, needs a factor of 0.064-0.108; both take the sky's own 40th percentile from 0.00091 to 0.00000, i.e. every faint star and the whole nebula go to pure black, and the peak pixel falls from 236-252 to 67-90. Measured, rendered and looked at: a dark grey smudge.
records.translation: :data:`TARGET_SKY_PERCENTILE`은 평균이 아니라 *빈 하늘*이 :data:`TARGET_SKY_LUMA`에 오도록 프레임의 노출을 정합니다. 이는 의도된 것으로, 태양이 과다 노출된 채로 남고 프레임 전체를 검게 끌어내리지 않게 하기 위함입니다. 하나의 전역 노출에 대한 진술로 보면 이는 이제 한계와 정면으로 양립할 수 없으며, 이를 강제하는 두 가지 뻔한 방법은 모두 그림을 망칩니다. 노출을 다시 계산하거나 완성된 프레임을 :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.solve_dim`으로 어둡게 하려면 0.064-0.108의 계수가 필요합니다. 둘 다 하늘 자체의 40번째 백분위수를 0.00091에서 0.00000으로 만듭니다. 즉, 모든 어두운 별과 성운 전체가 완전한 검은색이 되고, 최대 픽셀 값은 236-252에서 67-90으로 떨어집니다. 측정하고 렌더링하여 살펴본 결과: 짙은 회색 얼룩이었습니다.

records.context: The reconciliation is that the two rules are about different things. The exposure anchor is about a *pixel with nothing in it*; the WCAG limit is about the mean over a **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`), which is the point :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` already makes about photographs — every photograph has a white pixel somewhere and it is a bright *patch* that makes a caption unreadable. A 3 px star inside a 202x48 px text window moves that window's mean by a quarter of one per cent; the whole starfield measured on its own comes to 0.0007-0.0067, i.e. 1-11 % of the limit. A 207 px sun disc fills the window completely and cannot.
records.label: spacr.qt.space#16

records.source: The reconciliation is that the two rules are about different things. The exposure anchor is about a *pixel with nothing in it*; the WCAG limit is about the mean over a **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`), which is the point :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` already makes about photographs — every photograph has a white pixel somewhere and it is a bright *patch* that makes a caption unreadable. A 3 px star inside a 202x48 px text window moves that window's mean by a quarter of one per cent; the whole starfield measured on its own comes to 0.0007-0.0067, i.e. 1-11 % of the limit. A 207 px sun disc fills the window completely and cannot.
records.translation: 두 규칙은 서로 다른 대상에 관한 것이라는 점이 조정의 핵심입니다. 노출 기준점은 *아무것도 없는 픽셀*에 관한 것이고, WCAG 한계는 **텍스트 한 줄 크기의 영역**(:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`)에 대한 평균에 관한 것입니다. 이는 :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery`가 이미 사진에 대해 지적하는 점이기도 합니다 — 모든 사진에는 어딘가에 흰 픽셀이 있으며, 캡션을 읽을 수 없게 만드는 것은 밝은 *부분 영역*입니다. 202x48 px 텍스트 창 안의 3 px 별은 그 창의 평균을 0.25퍼센트만큼 움직일 뿐이며, 별 필드 전체만 따로 측정하면 0.0007-0.0067, 즉 한계의 1-11 %입니다. 207 px 태양 원반은 창을 완전히 채우므로 그렇지 않습니다.

records.context: So the exposure anchor is kept exactly as it was — the sky background is unchanged, to the byte — and the limit is enforced where it is actually violated, by compressing the highlights of the **smooth** layers only (:func:`_compress_highlights`, applied to nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom, never to the starfield). The sun therefore does get noticeably darker, which is the accepted cost; the galaxy is barely touched because it was never the offender; the stars keep white cores and diffraction spikes. :func:`_enforce_legibility` then measures the finished frame with the same :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` used on the photographs and applies whatever residual dim is left, so the guarantee is a measurement and not an argument.
records.label: spacr.qt.space#17
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the exposure anchor is kept exactly as it was — the sky background is unchanged, to the byte — and the limit is enforced where it is actually violated, by compressing the highlights of the **smooth** layers only (:func:`_compress_highlights`, applied to nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom, never to the starfield). The sun therefore does get noticeably darker, which is the accepted cost; the galaxy is barely touched because it was never the offender; the stars keep white cores and diffraction spikes. :func:`_enforce_legibility` then measures the finished frame with the same :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` used on the photographs and applies whatever residual dim is left, so the guarantee is a measurement and not an argument.
records.translation: 따라서 노출 기준점은 정확히 그대로 유지되고 — 하늘 배경은 바이트 하나까지 변하지 않습니다 — 한계는 실제로 위반되는 곳에서, **매끄러운** 레이어의 하이라이트만 압축하여 적용됩니다(:func:`_compress_highlights`, 성운 + 은하 + 태양 + 블룸에 적용하며 별 필드에는 적용하지 않음). 그 결과 태양은 눈에 띄게 어두워지며 이는 감수한 비용입니다. 은하는 처음부터 문제가 아니었으므로 거의 바뀌지 않고, 별은 흰색 중심부와 회절 스파이크를 유지합니다. 그런 다음 :func:`_enforce_legibility`가 사진에 사용하는 것과 같은 :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window`로 완성된 프레임을 측정하고 남은 어둡게 하기를 적용하므로, 보장은 논증이 아니라 측정에 근거합니다.

records.translation: ``starfield`` 유클리드 수 계수 법칙(``N(>F) ∝ F^-3/2``)에서 추출한 등급 분포 — 어두운 별은 많고 밝은 별은 매우 적음 — 를 사용하며, 별의 색은 뜨거운 청색 O/B에서 흰색 A/F/G를 거쳐 차가운 적색 K/M에 이르는 흑체 궤적에서 샘플링합니다. 4방향 회절 스파이크는 가장 밝은 소수의 별에만 그립니다.

records.context: It must not disappear while the pointer moves toward it. The pointer has to cross the gap between the row and the panel, and a plain leave-event dismissal closes it mid-journey, which makes the Install link unreachable. The hide is a timer, the timer is cancelled on entry, and while it is pending the cursor is checked against the corridor -- the union of the anchor's rectangle and the panel's -- so travelling through the gap re-arms the timer instead of firing it. records.source: Rank per-object measurements by class-separation performance.
records.translation: 객체별 측정값을 클래스 분리 성능에 따라 순위를 매깁니다.

records.context: The default statistic is the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), computed from the Mann–Whitney U statistic. Results are reported as the unit-free separation ``|2·AUC − 1|`` in ``[0, 1]`` together with the direction of the class difference. AUC is rank based and therefore invariant under monotonic transformations; it does not require normality, equal variance or symmetry. These properties allow measurements with different units and distributions to be compared in one ranking.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The default statistic is the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), computed from the Mann–Whitney U statistic. Results are reported as the unit-free separation ``|2·AUC − 1|`` in ``[0, 1]`` together with the direction of the class difference. AUC is rank based and therefore invariant under monotonic transformations; it does not require normality, equal variance or symmetry. These properties allow measurements with different units and distributions to be compared in one ranking.
records.translation: 기본 통계량은 수신자 조작 특성 곡선 아래 면적(AUC)이며, Mann–Whitney U 통계량으로 계산합니다. 결과는 단위 없는 분리도 ``|2·AUC − 1|``(``[0, 1]`` 범위)와 클래스 차이의 방향으로 함께 보고됩니다. AUC는 순위 기반이므로 단조 변환에 대해 불변이며, 정규성, 등분산성, 대칭성을 요구하지 않습니다. 이러한 성질 덕분에 단위와 분포가 서로 다른 측정값을 하나의 순위에서 비교할 수 있습니다.

records.context: Return True after writing the PNG displayed by the GUI. Failure of the *related PDF* does not return False. Callers interpret False as "no pixmap, no thumbnail", which would incorrectly remove the figure. Instead, log a warning. :meth:`FigureQueue._request_pdf_refinement` detects the missing page and stops waiting for it.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Returns True once the PNG — the raster the GUI actually displays — is on disk. A failed *sibling PDF* does not turn that into False, and the asymmetry is deliberate rather than sloppy: the callers turn False into "no pixmap, no thumbnail", so reporting a missing export that way would delete the figure from the gallery over a file nothing has asked for yet. It is logged at WARNING instead, and :meth:`FigureQueue._request_pdf_refinement` notices the absent page, says so, and stops waiting for a render that will never arrive.

The strip is built by the generic `AppScreen`, which knows nothing about this table's columns -- it is four buttons in a QHBoxLayout, and every module's example-data row is built the same way. This widget is the only object that knows what the columns ARE, and it is the only widget in the form that is Regression's alone, so the knowledge and the alignment are kept in the same place.
records.translation: 띠가 표를 찾는 것이 아니라 표가 위로 띠를 찾아가는 이유. 띠는 범용 `AppScreen` 클래스가 만들며, 이 클래스는 이 표의 열에 대해 아무것도 모릅니다 -- 띠는 QHBoxLayout 안의 버튼 네 개이며, 모든 모듈의 예제 데이터 행이 같은 방식으로 만들어집니다. 열이 무엇인지 아는 객체는 이 위젯뿐이고, 양식에서 Regression에만 속하는 위젯도 이것뿐이므로, 그 지식과 정렬을 같은 곳에 둡니다.

records.context: **The whole table, never the filtered view.** ``zscore(area)`` computed over whatever the Local Data Filter currently shows would change every time a slider moved, so the column would not be stable: two charts drawn a second apart would disagree, and an exported CSV would record one arbitrary moment. So :func:`compute` is given the loaded frame and the aggregates (:data:`AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS`) reduce over all of it. Filtering happens afterwards, to the computed column like any other.
records.translation: **필터링된 보기가 아니라 항상 표 전체입니다.** Local Data Filter가 현재 보여 주는 것에 대해 ``zscore(area)``를 계산하면 슬라이더가 움직일 때마다 값이 바뀌어 열이 안정적이지 않게 됩니다: 1초 간격으로 그린 두 차트가 서로 다르고, 내보낸 CSV는 임의의 한 순간을 기록하게 됩니다. 그래서 :func:`compute`는 불러온 프레임을 받으며, 집계 함수(:data:`AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS`)는 그 전체에 대해 축약합니다. 필터링은 그 이후에 다른 열과 마찬가지로 계산된 열에 적용됩니다.

records.source: Two rules apply to what the preview reports.
records.translation: 미리 보기가 보고하는 내용에는 두 가지 규칙이 적용됩니다.

records.context: **Units.** The assay converts pixels per frame into physical units with ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` and only when *both* are known; otherwise it reports ``px/frame``. So that a velocity is never read in the wrong unit, the calibration fields start **unset**, every velocity carries its unit, and while the calibration is unknown the panel says so in words instead of silently using the 1.78 px/µm default.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Units.** The assay converts pixels per frame into physical units with ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` and only when *both* are known; otherwise it reports ``px/frame``. So that a velocity is never read in the wrong unit, the calibration fields start **unset**, every velocity carries its unit, and while the calibration is unknown the panel says so in words instead of silently using the 1.78 px/µm default.
records.translation: **단위.** 분석은 ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)``로 프레임당 픽셀을 물리 단위로 변환하며, 이는 *둘 다* 알려진 경우에만 해당합니다. 그렇지 않으면 ``px/frame``으로 보고합니다. 속도를 잘못된 단위로 읽는 일이 없도록 보정 필드는 **미설정** 상태로 시작하고, 모든 속도에는 단위가 붙으며, 보정을 알 수 없는 동안 패널은 1.78 px/µm 기본값을 조용히 사용하지 않고 그렇다고 글로 알립니다.

records.context: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. records.translation: **짧은 트랙.** 평균 이동 거리와 직진성은 세 점짜리 트랙에서 불안정합니다 — 두 점짜리 트랙의 직진성은 세포가 무엇을 했든 정확히 1.0입니다. 그래서 트랙 길이 분포를 컷오프 표시와 함께 속도 플롯 옆에 그리며, 최소 길이는 어떤 트랙이 속도와 직진성 수치에 들어갈지 결정하는 실시간 설정입니다.

records.context: The expensive half (reading merged arrays and extracting centroids) runs once in a background execution unit and is **cached** as a point table. Measured on one workstation, one stat under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds.

records.source: Why the scores plot is a GraphCanvas

records.context: A PCA scores plot is a scatter of two continuous columns that a user wants to colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID``, and brush to pull a cluster into Annotate. That is the Graph Builder, exactly, with the two columns computed rather than measured. So :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` appends ``PC1…PCk`` to the source frame and :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` is a :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` subclass that draws arrows on top.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A PCA scores plot is a scatter of two continuous columns that a user wants to colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID``, and brush to pull a cluster into Annotate. That is the Graph Builder, exactly, with the two columns computed rather than measured. So :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` appends ``PC1…PCk`` to the source frame and :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` is a :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` subclass that draws arrows on top.
records.translation: PCA 점수 플롯은 두 연속형 열의 산점도로, 사용자는 이를 ``gene``으로 색을 칠하고, ``plateID``로 패싯을 나누며, 브러시로 클러스터를 Annotate로 가져오고 싶어 합니다. 이는 두 열을 측정하는 대신 계산한다는 점만 빼면 정확히 Graph Builder입니다. 그래서 :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>`이 원본 프레임에 ``PC1…PCk``를 덧붙이고, :class:`PCAScoresCanvas`는 그 위에 화살표를 그리는 :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` 하위 클래스입니다.

records.context: Everything that took work in the Graph Builder therefore already works here and cannot drift out of step with it: the shared-scale facet grid, the fixed categorical colour order, the large-data policy and its notice, the selection-dims-never-hides rule, and the brush. Because the scores frame carries the object identifier columns, a rectangle dragged around a cluster in PC space publishes a real :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`, and the UMAP, the laboratory microplate map and the extracted-image-region grid highlight the same cells. Reimplementing a scatter here would have meant reimplementing all of that and getting the brush subtly wrong.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view#4

records.source: Everything that took work in the Graph Builder therefore already works here and cannot drift out of step with it: the shared-scale facet grid, the fixed categorical colour order, the large-data policy and its notice, the selection-dims-never-hides rule, and the brush. Because the scores frame carries the object key columns, a rectangle dragged around a cluster in PC space publishes a real :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`, and the UMAP, the plate map and the crop grid highlight the same cells. Reimplementing a scatter here would have meant reimplementing all of that and getting the brush subtly wrong.
records.translation: 따라서 Graph Builder에서 공들여 만든 모든 것이 여기서도 이미 동작하며, 그것과 어긋날 수 없습니다: 공유 척도 패싯 그리드, 고정된 범주형 색상 순서, 대용량 데이터 정책과 그 알림, 선택은 흐리게만 하고 숨기지 않는다는 규칙, 그리고 브러시. 점수 프레임에는 객체 키 열이 있으므로, PC 공간에서 클러스터 주위로 드래그한 사각형은 실제 :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`을 게시하며, UMAP, 플레이트 맵, 크롭 그리드가 같은 세포를 강조합니다. 여기서 산점도를 다시 구현했다면 그 모든 것을 다시 구현하고 브러시를 미묘하게 잘못 만들었을 것입니다.

records.context: Three of those rows were bugs rather than differences of taste. Measure returned after extracting image regions again without a word when no array was loaded, so the button did nothing and said nothing. Timelapse and Motility wired ``QThread.finished`` to ``worker.deleteLater`` and dropped their own reference in the result slot — the pattern :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents as a race, and the one the Mask panel had already been fixed away from — which leaves a running ``QThread`` owned by nobody when the user closes the application view mid-pass. And Measure never told anyone its pass had landed, so no application view could react to an extracted image region preview the way it reacts to the other three.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract#56
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three of those rows were bugs rather than differences of taste. Measure returned from its re-crop without a word when no array was loaded, so the button did nothing and said nothing. Timelapse and Motility wired ``QThread.finished`` to ``worker.deleteLater`` and dropped their own reference in the result slot — the pattern :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents as a race, and the one the Mask panel had already been fixed away from — which leaves a running ``QThread`` owned by nobody when the user closes the screen mid-pass. And Measure never told anyone its pass had landed, so no screen could react to a crop preview the way it reacts to the other three.
records.translation: 그중 세 행은 취향의 차이가 아니라 버그였습니다. Measure는 배열이 로드되지 않았을 때 아무 말 없이 재크롭에서 반환했으므로, 버튼이 아무것도 하지 않고 아무것도 알리지 않았습니다. Timelapse와 Motility는 ``QThread.finished``를 ``worker.deleteLater``에 연결하고 결과 슬롯에서 자신의 참조를 버렸습니다 — :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`가 경쟁 상태로 문서화한 패턴이자 Mask 패널에서는 이미 수정된 패턴으로 — 이 때문에 사용자가 처리 도중 화면을 닫으면 아무도 소유하지 않은 ``QThread``가 실행 중인 채로 남습니다. 그리고 Measure는 처리가 끝났다는 사실을 아무에게도 알리지 않았으므로, 어떤 화면도 다른 세 가지에 반응하듯 크롭 미리 보기에 반응할 수 없었습니다.

records.context: Nothing on this tab touches a processing-session folder from the main GUI execution path. On one workstation a single ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- did not return within twenty seconds. Every row here carries a folder the user chose, so walking, stat-ing, reading and deleting those folders (the sweep table read on a tab change, ``describe_folder``'s ``os.walk`` inside the delete confirmation, ``shutil.rmtree`` after it, and ``workspace.has_workspace`` while the row menu is built) run on a :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`. The one remaining existence check -- which folder to open the chooser in -- is answered from :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`'s cache.
